newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures end last day of year lower.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures end last day of year lower.

text.p: Dec 31 - U.S. stock index futures finished the last session of the year sharply lower and near session lows set in the final minutes of trade. Traders said volume was extremely light, with what few small orders from dealers that entered the pits having an exaggerated impact on prices. All U.S. markets are closed Wednesday for the New Year's Day holiday.
